title: Der Wolkenflüsterer
teaser: Die Wolken sind grau und traurig. Firlefanz macht sich auf den Weg zu den Wolkenbergen, um den Wolkenflüsterer zu finden!
prompt: Firlefanz notices the clouds are sad and grey. He journeys to the Cloud Mountains to find the Wolkenflüsterer, a gentle creature who paints the clouds their colors. The Wolkenflüsterer has lost his brushes and together they search for them. When they find the brushes, they repaint the sky in beautiful sunset hues. Firlefanz gets to paint one cloud himself — it becomes his favorite shape.

title: Die Traumfabrik
teaser: Woher kommen eigentlich Träume? Firlefanz will es herausfinden und reist zur geheimnisvollen Traumfabrik!
prompt: Firlefanz keeps having the same dream every night and wonders where dreams come from. He and Papalapapp travel to a hidden factory floating in the sky where tiny fluffy creatures weave dreams like cotton candy on spinning wheels. The factory chief, a sleepy owl named Schnurr, shows them around. Firlefanz gets to design his own dream and takes it home in a glass jar to put under his pillow.

title: Der Mondgarten
teaser: Firlefanz sieht eine leuchtende Blume auf dem Mond. Ob es dort oben einen geheimen Garten gibt?
prompt: Firlefanz spots a glowing flower on the moon through his window. He and Papalapapp journey upward through star-lit paths and glowing stepping stones to discover a secret garden on the moon where everything grows upside down. A shy moon gardener named Lunella tends luminous flowers that chime softly. She gives Firlefanz a moon seed to plant at home — it glows at night like a tiny nightlight.

title: Das Lied der Meerjungfische
teaser: Eine wunderschöne Melodie kommt aus dem Meer. Firlefanz taucht hinab, um die singenden Fische zu finden!
prompt: Firlefanz hears a beautiful melody drifting from the sea. He and Papalapapp travel to the coast and descend into a gentle underwater kingdom in a magic bubble. There they find the Meerjungfische — singing fish who compose lullabies for the ocean. Their conductor, a wise old seahorse named Melodius, teaches Firlefanz a special lullaby. Firlefanz brings the song home and hums it every night before sleep.
